title: Pilchards on toast
summary: A South African favourite: cheap, quick, full of protein and omega-3.
steps: Tip the pilchards and their sauce into a small pan and warm them over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, mashing lightly with a fork.
Meanwhile toast the bread and chop the tomato.
Pile the pilchards onto the toast, top with the tomato and season with black pepper, and a pinch of chilli if you like.
